annotations.title: Find the answer to an SAP AI & analytics problem

description: Start here when someone asks about an SAP AI & analytics PROBLEM rather than a term. Matches a natural question, in English, French or German, to the twelve ranked challenges Analytics Legends tracks: agents in production, Joule value, AI cost, AI-ready data, on-premise reach, the open ecosystem, the BW cliff, BDC versus Datasphere versus Databricks, staffing, roadmap volatility, EU compliance, end of BI 4.3. Returns at most three rows: the short answer, what shipped, what is announced, what slipped or is unconfirmed, facts outside the status registry with their source and quality, next steps, review date and citation_url. Statuses are read from the SAP announcement registry; a date is a plan, not a commitment. An empty result means the question is outside these challenges: say so and use search_concepts, find_academy_modules or get_day_rate_benchmark.

audience.description: Who is asking. It only reorders challenges that already matched, it never adds one.

lang.description: Language of the answer. Omit it to answer in the language detected from the question, EN, FR or DE.

question.description: The question as the person asked it, in English, French or German. Full sentences match best.
